minor.issue: Ticket is flagged night_alert_sent=True before the fire-and-forget push; if the relay fails (5xx/timeout) the alert is never retried (unlike notify.py reminder loop which resets the flag). Acceptable but no retry.
Query on tickets {event_date range, night_alert_sent} every 5 min has no supporting index; consider IndexModel([('event_date',1)]) for scale.
user['full_name'].split(' ')[0] runs after the ticket is inserted; a user doc without full_name would raise KeyError -> 500 after the ticket is written. Use user.get('full_name') or 'Someone'.

issues: Switch OFF-state track (colors.surfaceTertiary) is barely visible on the surfaceSecondary row background; only the white thumb shows, so OFF state reads weakly. Consider a lighter off track or border.
